name: How do kitchen clearance improvements differ from a full kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do kitchen clearance improvements differ from a full kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen clearance improvements focus specifically on optimizing the distances and spacing within your existing kitchen layout, often involving adjustments to cabinets, appliances, or minimal structural changes to meet safety and ergonomic standards. A full kitchen remodel, conversely, is a much larger project that typically involves a complete overhaul of the layout, new cabinetry, countertops, flooring, and often changes to plumbing and electrical systems throughout the entire space. Clearance improvements are generally more targeted and less disruptive.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clearance improvements optimize existing spacing and distances, while a full remodel involves a complete overhaul of the kitchen's layout and components.
